result.brief: 提出知识迁移探测协议，检验统一多模态模型通过图像生成训练获得的新知识能否迁移到纯文本问答，并引入文本对齐与图文交错对齐来连接生成与回答。
result.reason: Probes whether image-generation training in unified multimodal models transfers knowledge to text QA, with alignment objectives linking generation and answering—direct evidence for unified understanding/generation.
